title: Mixed Event — The Climax! Kamiyama Cheer Squad!

meta.Outline: With the Sports Festival just around the corner, Kamiyama High School is abuzz with talk of the renowned cheering competition, which also piques Rui's interest. Suddenly, Mizuki approaches him with a request...

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: And so, these gentlemen have been selected to join the cheer squad for the Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Um... Thank you for choosing us!
We'll do everything we can to get the blue team as excited as we can!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: We'll be counting on your support, so let's all give it our best shot!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: The theme of this year's cheering competition will be the “Three Kingdoms”. I realize that you have a lot of work ahead of you, but I'll be looking forward to seeing it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(The cheer squad...
I guess the Sports Festival will soon be upon us.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Our school's cheering competition's often touted as a famed tradition, but I wonder what it's really like...)

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Hey, did your class already decide who's gonna be on the cheer squad?

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Yeah. Ours are already meeting up, so I've gotta think the other classes are all squared away too. Rumor has it that the red team's super hyped...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The Sports Festival, or rather the cheer squads, seem to be all everyone's talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But the ones on the cheer squad must also be feeling the pressure...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (If it's that interesting, I can't wait to see what they have in store for us.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, there he is!
Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, what brings you two here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's something we'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui, your class is on the blue team, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I knew it!
My class is on the blue team too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh?
That means we'll get to fight alongside each other in battle.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I'd like to ask my soon-to-be war buddy a little favor...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Would you mind giving the blue team's cheer squad a hand?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Our class chose us for the cheer squad!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The cheer squad...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Shiraishi I understand, but Mizuki?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're supposed to come up with ideas for the cheering competition, but the thing is... It's pretty freestyle.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Based on what I heard...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Last time, the theme was the “Savannah”, so everyone danced while dressed as animals.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Everyone's super stoked about it, so I guess it's a pretty big deal...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I can come up with ideas and stuff...
But if we're serious about winning, we'll probably need to come up with something really original, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why we came to ask you, Rui!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What you did for the wedding that one time was so awesome. That's when we thought you'd be able to help us out with this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, our team captain's really hoping you'll take up this offer...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The captain of the cheer squad...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's right. So...
Will you help us with the cheering competition?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I get that you're not the biggest fan of these kinds of events...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But please... I beg you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I understand your situation...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But my class already chose its members for the cheer squad. Would it be okay for someone like me to...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, we already got the green light for that! Last time, they had a squad member's mom direct everything because she just happened to be a dance teacher.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which means you don't actually have to participate in the cheering competition to support them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... In that case, there shouldn't be any problems.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Based on what I've heard, Kamiyama High's cheering competition is supposed to be a show that “captivates the audience”. On top of being very interesting, it's an honor to be a part of that.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'll need to see the scope of my “stage” and make sure to communicate well with each squad member, who aren't actors by trade. In many ways, this is going to be an intriguing technical test...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm? That face...
Does this mean you're interested but conflicted? You still have your PXL shows to worry about, so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know. The next time you're free, you could pop in to introduce yourself to everyone on the cheer squad!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm sure you'll get a better idea of what to do once you get a chance to speak with the captain.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Your help is bound to make our performance a great one, so please stop by if you get a chance! We meet every day!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, alright...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I'll drop in for a visit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You will?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I have some time later today, so would you mind showing me where everyone will be meeting?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Got it!
Mizuki and I can come get you after school, so just wait in your classroom!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Mizuki being this interested in a school event... I can't help but wonder if something's going on...)
After school
Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here we are!
This is where the cheer squad for the blue team's meeting!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, an empty classroom.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Looks like the squad members from the other classes are already here.)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line:
Huh? Kamishiro...?
From the Weirdo Wombo Combo...?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: He's the super helper that the captain and the others were talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I take it Mizuki told them about having a director as a friend.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Also, they weren't expecting me to be brought here so soon... I suppose their reactions are warranted based on my reputation at school.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Um, so...
Rui's here to observe today!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: For those who don't already know Kamishiro... Oh, who am I kidding? Since we're all here, let's go around and introduce ourselves.
If you don't mind, I'd like to say something before we start.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you must be...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: The third-year captain of the blue team's cheer squad. Please, call me “Captain”.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm Rui Kamishiro, a second-year...
It's nice to meet you, Captain.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Yes, I'm well aware of who you are, Kamishiro. Having you on board to help us with our performance will be a huge shot in the arm for us.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Now, I'd like to get down to nuts and bolts...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, Captain, hold up!
Rui hasn't actually agreed to anything yet!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Like we said, he's just here to observe for now!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
R-Right...
I apologize for getting ahead of myself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I must apologize as well...
I'm certainly interested in trying my hand at something new like the cheering competition...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I first need to see what I'm up against, hence I'd like to observe for now.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
I see...
It would be unfair of us to ask you to dive straight into the deep end.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: However, there's something I need you to hear before we discuss any details regarding our performance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What might that be...?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: The passion I feel for the Sports Festival!
Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The passion you feel for the Sports Festival...?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Yes. I believe in the power that cheering can bestow upon others. As such, I've been on the cheer squad for the Sports Festival every time since I was a first year.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I've dedicated my entire high school life to the cheer squad... However, I had the misfortune of losing to my archrival last time.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: The blue team won the sports portion, but the red team managed to pull off a comeback by receiving the most votes during the cheering competition.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, the captain mentioned that.
Our teacher said the same thing today too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That was a pretty big shock, right?
Everyone apparently thought the blue team already had it in the books.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
And I was on the blue team...
This sense of regret wells up inside of me every time I think about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: But regret isn't all that I've been feeling. Since then, I've spent quite a lot of time thinking about why we lost that time.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
That's when I made a realization.
The joy I felt after winning during my first year drove me towards becoming obsessed with defeating my archrival.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: The power that cheering can bestow upon others... I'd forgotten all about the people I initially hoped to empower and encourage.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Losing was simply the natural outcome of that. Nonetheless, I'll be seeking revenge as I participate in my final cheering competition...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I want to win it while getting the festivities to reach a fever pitch. I want everyone to be glad they were on the blue team and make this the best Sports Festival ever for them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (A fever pitch, eh...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
I think I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: You do?!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I knew you would, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You did...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Shiraishi also said that you asked for me specifically... Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that? It sounded like the captain already knew about you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: When I had to come up with ideas for the cheer squad on my own, I kept hitting so many mental blocks...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Then, I just happened to see one of your shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: One of our shows?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Yes. The way the actors drew the audience into their breathtaking world... All the warmth I felt just by watching the story unfold...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I became convinced that the director of that show would know how to turn my ideas for the cheering competition into reality!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
And so, you asked to meet with me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You should've seen the look on the captain's face when I said that we're friends.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What if this is more than just a coincidence?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, Kamishiro, the ball's in your court...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm grateful for everything you mentioned just now and I am interested, but...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I understand that you're a very busy person, Kamishiro. But before you make your decision, please let me ask you about my ideas for the competition. I've been working on them since the previous Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: You said that you'd like to know what I had in mind, no? If that's true, take a look at this.
se_event_cheerteam_2022_006

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is as thick as a dictionary. Are these all your ideas?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
No, not all of them.
I still have two or three more stacks.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, there's more of these?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. I'm pretty sure anyone would freeze up when a giant stack of papers is dumped in front of them like this. I honestly had the same reaction.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But seeing this for myself...
It kinda changed my impression.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We drew straws to see who'd be chosen for the cheer squad. I hate to say it now, but I wasn't all that interested at first...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: ...is how I feel going into the cheering competition. Will you help me?!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was really glad An was also chosen, but stuff that encourages “camaraderie” still really isn't my thing...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Unfortunately, I don't really have a choice now.)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: The cheering competition itself will proceed as I just mentioned. Now, I'd like it if you could all take a look at the ideas I've come up for it. Don't be afraid to give me your honest opinion.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Wait, this is thicker than a dictionary... He came up with all of these?!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (F-For now, I'll read through some of them.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Alright, let's see...
Gather all the blue team members' headbands to make a big ring. Okay, seems pretty standard.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But it says, “Rejected.”
Oh, it doesn't go with the theme... I guess so.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(What about this page?
Oh, specs for all the equipment being used for the Sports Festival. Here are the heights for the platform and flagpoles...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Wait, did the captain look up all this stuff on his own? Does that mean he climbed the flagpoles to get these measurements...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(And these other ideas...
I was expecting to see a big mess of scribbled notes, but that's not the case at all.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Jumping into a fire while twirling a weapon around... It wouldn't be easy, but it would look so cool if we pulled that off.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Oh, wait...
“Rejected. The school won't allow us to use fire.”)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(That's too bad...
If it were me, I'd have a video...)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
What do you think?
Anything catch your interest?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, mind if I say something?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The one that involves soldiers marching around. I think it'd look really cool if they did dance steps in unison...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Oh?
Can you expand on that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um... I saw some other people do it at this one event. I can't describe it right now, but I'll be sure to look it up later tonight! I really think it'll go well with this idea!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's already in the mood to get this off the ground.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, I can see why too...)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Yes, excellent!
We can discuss that tomorrow.
Alright, Akiyama, how about you...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh?
M-Me...? Um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
W-Well...
The one that involves using fire...
I think it's really unfortunate that it's been rejected.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I get that fire makes things tricky...
However, we could just show a video instead. That way, we'd also be able to do all sorts of other stuff!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Just kidding...!
I mean, you already rejected it once, so we should probably think of something different...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
I like it!
Let's keep that in mind as we move forward.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: This was actually one of my favorite ideas, so it pained me to have to give up on it...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: But a video would definitely make that possible! Thank you for this, Akiyama!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: B-But... I literally came up with that just now? Are you sure you want to run with it?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Nonsense. I asked for your honest opinion, no? Not only did you and Shiraishi do just that, you even came up with your own ideas.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: And it's clear to me that your suggestions would result in a better outcome, so there's no reason to not consider them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A better outcome...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's not exactly the same, but this process feels kinda similar to when we're making music.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That made me want to become a better video editor and learn how to be more evocative.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
...is what happened.
After that, I was totally on board with everything.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
It must've been a tremendous idea if it got you this excited about it, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
At the same time...
I think I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (To be honest, these ideas by themselves are rather crude. They don't fit together well and leave much to be desired.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, even a professional director would struggle to come up with so many ideas for one theme...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This must be the passion he was talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I want to win it while getting the festivities to reach a fever pitch. I want everyone to be glad they were on the blue team and make this the best Sports Festival ever for them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “The power that cheering can bestow upon others,” huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When I first heard that, it reminded me of my own dream... “To make others smile through my shows.” In that case...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This may be worth a try.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I accept your offer.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Captain, I'll do my best to come up with a performance that grants everyone the power you mentioned before.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: K-Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
This is gonna be the best cheering competition ever!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Way to go, Captain!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: But I really need to thank you both for letting Kamishiro know about this, Akiyama, Shiraishi! I couldn't be more grateful!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that we've settled that, we can look forward to getting things rolling tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, Mizuki, there's something I'd like you to do as we get ready for the day of. Mind lending me a hand?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Me?
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So I agreed to be their director for the cheering competition...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Whoa! That sounds really fun!
Just hearing you say, “Cheering competition,” is getting me super excited☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting both you and Tsukasa to join the cheer squad.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What?
Tsukasa also joined the cheer squad?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, he sent a message saying...
<I won't be able to make our meeting in SEKAI as I've been chosen to become the vice captain of the red team's cheer squad.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that explains why he isn't here today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Does that mean you two are gonna be busy for a little while, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I didn't actually join the cheer squad. I'm just there to help them... But I suppose I'm a de facto member since I'll be working with them hand in hand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, this is my first time hearing of Tsukasa joining the cheer squad. We're on the blue team, so we'll be facing each other as opponents.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean you and Tsukasa are gonna have a big showdown during the cheering competition?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No fair! I wanna cheer too...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, let's cheer them on together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: As much as I want to, I have to help out with the gymnastics club at this really big tournament that day...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Emu, you're in the gymnastics club?!
That's so cool☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I go to lots of other clubs too!
I try to help out whenever someone really needs help!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's sad that I can't go to Kamiyama High's Sports Festival... So you guys are gonna need to cheer for the others in my place!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you guys are gonna come watch?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Obviously!
We cheered during Emu's Sports Festival, so we've gotta do the same during your guys' Sports Festival☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hold on. If Tsukasa's on the red team, and Rui's on the blue team... Which team are you on, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm on the green team.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I had no idea.
That splits us up rather nicely.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Like the real “Three Kingdoms”.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “Three Kingdoms”?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, we failed to mention that.
Our school's Sports Festival will be going with a “Three Kingdoms” theme this year.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see.
That sounds like a tough theme.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I remember seeing that in one of the books you guys brought over! But it was a bit too much for me, so I couldn't finish it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What kind of story is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Simply put, it's about these three kingdoms that are vying for power with the leader of each fiercely battling against one another...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: During the cheering competition, I'm thinking about having someone from the actual story appear so that others who aren't as familiar with it can enjoy the show... A famous general, such as Liu Bei...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, Liu Bei...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Liu-bei?
Do you know what they're talking about, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Liu-bi...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, I know♪
It's the green thing Kappas like to eat.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Apparently, they become very yummy after you let them cool for a while in a stream during summer.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I believe you're thinking of the Japanese word for cucumber.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Haha. Oh, Luka☆
But you're right about them sounding alike.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, darn...
Then, what were you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A man who drew a massive following and established his own kingdom during a time of war and turmoil. This is so we can get our theme out in the open, so there's no need to be familiar with the actual story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I'm struggling to find a good order for all our ideas. I want to include as many of them as possible, but getting them to mesh properly is proving to be a challenge...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The captain spent a whole year coming up with them, right? As tough as this task sounds, aren't there any helpful hints we can give him...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Cucumbers... Kappa... Water...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. They seem so at home in the water... Swimming together must be so much fun... Zzz...♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Swimming... In the water...
I plan to include a part that involves jumping in a fire...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But we're on the blue team...
It might be good to include some motifs that reflect our team color.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Combine that with Liu Bei and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rui, the speed at which you think and come up with ideas reminds me of Zhuge Liang.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's so cool, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also, Zhuge who...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You may want to go through that Three Kingdoms book again, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, this idea should do nicely.
I think I'll head home for the day to wrap it all up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, it's already that far along?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Way to go, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu

rows.Line:
Captain.
